title: A malicious actor with access to the adjacent network and under certain conditions could exploit a Stored Cross-Site…
description: CVE-2026-116836 is a high-severity Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability affecting airMAX M devices. An attacker with access to the adjacent network could exploit this vulnerability under certain conditions to escalate privileges on the device. The vulnerability allows for execution of malicious scripts that can compromise confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected device.
